revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_001
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 1, WHITE rank, based on the Chinese title concept "您也是辛苦了" (you worked hard walking). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is one consistent funny anthropomorphic foot mascot: a soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy little crown or hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face, silly but charming. Tier 1 pose: exhausted after walking, one tiny hand on its lower back, little sweat drops, slightly wobbly stance, cute tired grin. Keep the foot mascot clearly foot-based, not a human, not an animal.
Medal border: WHITE rank. Plain circular pearl-white / silver-white enamel border, minimal decoration, clean raised rim, subtle tiny white star studs only. Do not use green, blue, purple, orange, or gold as rank border colors.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central mascot fully inside circular core. Base circle size should match other tiers; decoration should stay inside safe margins.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights on medal metal and enamel; playful, cozy, polished.
Color palette: pearl white and silver border, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush accents, tiny teal/sage sweat drops; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 001-003 white, 004-006 green; future 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
